goal: The user has the AI they instruct run work overnight and receive its results in the morning: 「AI が作業を夜に流しておき、朝に結果を受け取れる。」 Once it holds, that AI, whether it calls overnight itself or through another plugin, leaves the work to run through the night while nobody answers, and in the morning takes in what came of it, where before the same work ran in the daytime.

deliverable.name: overnight's developers know whom overnight serves and the one way it brings them the night's results in the morning

decisions.decided: One role: the AI that the user instructs, whether it calls overnight itself or through another plugin. A plugin that calls overnight is that AI's way of calling it, and has no objective or key result of its own: 「ユーザーがAIに指示して、AIが段取る、なので利用者はAI」「Aをプラグインで呼び出したら同じだよね？」

decisions.about: who decides the one way and its ideas
decisions.decided: The maker decides the one way and each idea that carries it from the goal and the run's records, and asks the user none of them, as the user confirms only the purpose and the intent: 「目的はすでに伝えてるよね？ それ手段だよね？」 「私は目的と意図だけ確認したい、使い方や実装に興味ない、実現して欲しい」

decisions.about: a piece that the usage limit stops again and again
decisions.decided: The concept holds no idea of giving a piece up: such a piece waits out each reset like any other piece.

lines: - AI\
An AI that a person instructs, such as Claude Code, which leaves work to overnight before night.
- plugin maker\
One who makes another plugin, such as rn, and lets overnight carry its unattended work.
- O1: the AI gets the work it left before night done by morning, while nobody answers.
- O2: the plugin maker's plugin carries each piece of its unattended work past the usage limit.
- KR1.1: the share of the night's pieces whose whole result the AI can't take in by morning.
Lower is better.
- KR1.2: the steps the AI takes to leave the night's work and to take in its results. Fewer is
better.
- KR2.1: the share of the plugin's pieces stopped by the usage limit that never reach their end.
- O1: the AI gets the work it left before night done by morning, while nobody answers.
- O2: the plugin maker's plugin carries each piece of its unattended work past the usage limit.
overnight carries each piece left to it to its end, waiting out the usage limit, with nobody there.
- A start at the set time, for O1\
- Nothing to answer, for O1\
- Several pieces at once, each waiting on its own, for O1\
- A piece that can't finish given up, for O1\
- A morning record of each piece, for O1\
- The same waiting for other plugins, for O2\
